h: Yosef's Ushpiza: Riding on the High Places of the Earth

p: בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
"Of the night of Shabbos it is written (Yeshayahu 58:14):
'And I will make you ride upon the high places of the earth.'"
And in the Gemara (Shabbos 118b) it is brought:
"He is saved from subjugation to the kingdoms;
it is written here, 'And I will make you ride,' etc.,
'And you shall tread upon their high places.'"
are the roots of the kelipos,
and the first of the kelipah is Amalek,
and it stands against the holiness of the bris,
that they would cut off the circumcised parts
there are those who blemish this.
the dominion of the nations of the world
And opposite this is Yosef the tzaddik,
and "whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ וָאֵרָא, חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
as is written (holy Zohar, Va'eira, II 23a).
at the hand of the offspring of Yosef,
"And the house of Yosef a flame,
וּבֵית עֵשָׂו לְקַשׁ (רְאֵה בָּבָא בַתְרָא קכג, ב).
and the house of Esav for straw" (see Bava Basra 123b).
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה וַיֵּצֵא עג, ז)
And as is written (Bereishis Rabbah, Vayeitzei 73:7):
And similarly, of the sukkah it is brought
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רנה, ב)
that is, from the kelipah of the serpent,
that the serpent came upon Chavah
And we have already said (see above, maamar 7)
that the holiness of the Ushpizin
of his holiness upon all of Israel.
And when it is the Ushpiza of Yosef,
And Shabbos is in the secret of the bris,
as is written in the holy Zohar
And the Shabbos that comes during Sukkos,
and also when there falls on it
through the three holinesses we merit
And this is a preparation for Hoshana Rabbah,
and through him will be the victory
over the nations of the world;
(as is written in the Zohar Chadash, Vayeishev).
the great salvation from the yetzer hara:
and that they will merit to vanquish
all the roots of the yetzer hara.
And likewise there depends on this
the victory over the nations of the world,
in the root of the seven nations,
and since each one comprises ten,
they are the seventy kelipos of the nations.
from all the kelipos of the yetzer hara,
then automatically they will be saved:
"And you shall tread upon their high places."

paragraphs.text: Zohar II 88b (Yisro) — Rabbi Shimon said: Whoever completes the three meals on Shabbos, a voice goes out and proclaims of him: "Then you shall delight in Hashem" — this is the first meal…; "and I will feed you the inheritance of Yaakov your father" (Yeshayahu 58:14) — this is the completion, completed in Ze'eir Anpin.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Yosef Gikatilla, Shaarei Orah, Ninth Gate — “Around the letter vav of the Name all the princes of the nations surround, and from the letter vav upward, which is the secret of Yah, they have no ascent. [Of this it says,] ‘And you shall tread upon their high places’ (Devarim 33:29), and ‘I will make you ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed you the heritage of Yaakov your father’ (Yeshayahu 58:14).” Connection: Shaarei Orah explains the verse of Shabbos that Rav Tzadok cites as Israel rising to a place where the princes of the nations have no hold.

paragraphs.text: Shabbos 118b — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: Whoever gives delight to the Shabbos is granted the wishes of his heart, as it says, 'Delight in Hashem, and He will give you the wishes of your heart' (Tehillim 37:4). This delight — I do not know what it is; when it says, 'And you shall call the Shabbos a delight' (Yeshayahu 58:13), it is the delight of Shabbos." Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: he is saved from the subjugation of the exiles.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Rosh Chodesh Adar Sheni 1 — “The time in this month is for wiping out Amalek, who falls only at the hand of the offspring of Yosef, who is the opposite of Esav, as is reckoned in the Midrash (Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei 10); and so Amalek accuses against the holiness of Israel in this.” Connection: Both bring the saying that Esav falls only at the hand of Yosef's offspring.

paragraphs.text: Bava Basra 123b — “Rabbi Chelbo asked Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani: ‘When Rachel had borne Yosef’—what changed when Yosef was born? He answered: Yaakov our father saw that Esav’s offspring are delivered only into the hands of Yosef’s offspring, as it says, ‘The house of Yaakov will be fire, the house of Yosef a flame, and the house of Esav straw.’” The Gemara explains Yaakov’s readiness to leave Lavan after Yosef’s birth. Rav Tzadok describes the moral reversal that makes Yosef the opposing force to Esav.

paragraphs.text: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 255b (Pinchas) — "'And a sukkah shall be for shade by day' (Yeshayahu 4:6): we require s'chach, and the s'chach is made for shade… not the shade of an ordinary sukkah, which protects the body from the sun, but a shade to protect the soul: 'In his shade I delighted and sat' (Shir HaShirim 2:3)."

paragraphs.text: Shabbos 146a — “When the serpent came upon Chavah, it cast impurity into her. Israel, who stood at Mount Sinai, had their impurity cease; the nations, who did not stand at Mount Sinai, did not have their impurity cease. Rav Acha son of Rava asked Rav Ashi: What of converts? He answered: Though they themselves were not there, their heavenly counterparts were present, as it is written, ‘With those who stand here with us today before Hashem our God, and with those who are not here with us today.’”

paragraphs.text: Zohar Chadash, Vayeshev — When Yaakov saw the seven supernal years agreed upon to be famine in the world "for the sin that his sons caused by selling this holy tzaddik and removing him from his place," he prayed and five years were removed; and the reckoning of the years of exile is counted against the ten who sold him.
